sources.name: County Police injury and fatal crashes
sources.cadence: Weekly; approved reports can arrive later.
sources.coverage: Crashes investigated by County Police; municipal and Highway Patrol crashes are not comprehensively included. Property-damage-only crashes are omitted.

sources.name: County + participating municipal police crime reports
sources.cadence: Weekly; approved reports can arrive later.
sources.coverage: County Police patrol areas and participating municipal departments. Does not cover every municipality. Each case can include multiple reported offenses.

sources.name: SLMPD reviewed investigation and crash releases
sources.cadence: Reviewed daily; publication can lag occurrence.
sources.coverage: Selected City investigations and serious crashes. Press releases are not all City reports; do not compare these counts with the broader County feed.

sources.name: County Police reviewed releases
sources.coverage: Selected newer County investigations supplement the weekly structured feeds.

sources.name: SLMPD public crime map
sources.cadence: Updated daily; approvals can lag occurrence.
sources.coverage: City police public crime reports. Agency excludes domestic violence, sex crimes and juvenile-related offenses; homicides may appear late. Does not supply injury/death counts. Public-source exclusions are preserved.

sources.name: Florissant Police public crime map
sources.cadence: Public municipal feed; source approval and upload delays apply.
sources.coverage: Florissant municipal police reports, supplementing the County Police feed which does not include Florissant. This is not coverage of all County municipalities. Source does not supply injury/death counts; sensitive categories are excluded.

sources.name: County municipal investigations and Highway Patrol crash reporting
sources.cadence: Daily editorial review of dated, attributable reports; not a comprehensive incident feed.
sources.coverage: Reviewed County municipal police incidents and Highway Patrol crashes from First Alert 4 and KTTN. Sources and occurrence dates are retained on each report. Supplements County Police and Florissant feeds.

coverageNote: City and County are always shown together. City and Florissant public maps supplement County and participating municipal feeds, which update weekly. Agency exclusions and approval delays remain. These are reported incidents, not a complete regional census or safety ranking. Locations are approximate; unknown outcomes are not zero.
